page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmg7.32xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at a clock speed of 2.9 GHz. This instance features 128 dedicated physical cores with a single thread per core, resulting in 128 vCPUs. It is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. The instance operates on the KVM hypervisor and does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, requiring external block storage solutions for persistent data.

The instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers for distributed environments. Because the CPU allocation is fully dedicated with a 1:1 ratio of physical cores to vCPUs and no hyperthreading, workloads benefit from consistent, predictable compute performance without resource contention. This hardware profile represents a high-density resource configuration, offering qualitative cost efficiency for large-scale deployments that require substantial parallel processing capabilities without the overhead of multi-threading.

Given its balanced memory-to-core ratio and high core count, the ecs.ebmg7.32xlarge is suited for enterprise-grade general-purpose workloads. Appropriate use cases include large-scale web serving, application servers, containerized microservices, high-throughput batch processing, and distributed database nodes that rely on external network-attached storage.
